strategies.instructions: The provider endpoint is https://mcp.slack.com/mcp. Slack requires an eligible Marketplace or internal app and fixed app identity. Dynamic client registration is not supported. Configure the host app and callback, then use protected OAuth credential handling and selected user scopes. Service history/send access does not create a Slack frontend.
